name: Jari Koskinen
bio:
Jari Koskinen's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. Originally trained as an electrical engineer, he found himself drawn to the complexities of race logistics during a volunteer stint at a local rally event. He quickly realized that his analytical skills and meticulous nature were perfectly suited to the role. He joined Speed Kart Racing five years ago and has become an indispensable part of the team.

Jari's approach to logistics is rooted in practicality and efficiency. He's a firm believer in thorough planning and contingency measures, always striving to anticipate potential problems before they arise. While not one for flashy innovation, his systematic approach has consistently ensured smooth operations, earning him the respect of drivers and mechanics alike. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure, a trait that helps him keep the entire team focused during hectic race weekends.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jari is a lean man of average height with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Insists on a pre-race checklist, even for routine tasks.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
